results.title: Fully equipped Lenovo ThinkPad X220 motherboard with keyboard bezel.jpg
results.desc: This image shows the internal components of a Lenovo ThinkPad X220 with the black keyboard support bezel installed. The motherboard, FRU 04W3286, features a soldered Intel i5-2520M processor cooled by a Toshiba fan assembly, FRU 04W0435. A Crucial 2.5-inch Solid State Drive is installed in the main SATA bay. The full-size Mini PCIe slot is occupied by an Ericsson F5521gw module, a 3G mobile broadband card with built-in GPS that supports HSPA+ with download speeds up to 21 Mbps. The half-size Mini PCIe slot contains an AzureWave AW-AB116H, a dual-band Wi-Fi card based on the Atheros AR9462 chipset, supporting 802.11n up to 300 Mbps and Bluetooth 4.0. Additionally, a separate Bluetooth module, FRU 60Y3271, is installed. This is a Broadcom BCM92070MD card providing Bluetooth 3.0 connectivity

results.title: Inside of a Lenovo ThinkPad X220 magnesium alloy bottom case.jpg
results.desc: This is the inside view of the bottom case for a Lenovo ThinkPad X220. This chassis is constructed from a durable and lightweight magnesium alloy. A prominent feature is the large rectangular depression in the center, which corresponds to the location of the separate RAM access door on the exterior of the case, allowing for easy memory upgrades. Also visible are the bay for the 2.5-inch drive (left), various mounting points, and ventilation grilles. The sticker with FRU P/N 04W1416 likely refers to the foam padding itself, as this number is also associated with the memory door assembly

results.title: Lenovo ThinkPad X220 Motherboard (FRU 04W3286) with empty RAM slots.jpg
results.desc: This is the main logic board for a Lenovo ThinkPad X220, identified by the Field Replaceable Unit (FRU) number 04W3286. It features a soldered Intel Core i5-2520M processor from the Sandy Bridge architecture. The visible copper cooling assembly is made by Toshiba (FRU 04W0435). Both DDR3 SODIMM slots are populated with Crucial 8GB DDR3L-1866 CL13 modules, totaling 16GB. A key feature of the ThinkPad's robust design is visible: the square cutouts in the motherboard and the protective black Mylar film. These are part of the keyboard's spill-resistant drainage system. Liquid spilled on the keyboard is channeled through these holes, passing through the motherboard and exiting via corresponding holes in the bottom case, thus protecting the electronic components.

results.title: 7mm Hard drive caddy assembly for Lenovo ThinkPad X220.jpg
results.desc: This is the hardware required to install a 2.5-inch SATA drive into a Lenovo ThinkPad X220. A critical detail for the X220 is that its drive bay only accepts drives with a height of 7 mm, unlike the more common 9.5 mm drives. The kit consists of a perforated metal caddy that encloses the drive, two black rubber rails for shock absorption and a snug fit, and four screws to secure the drive within the caddy

results.title: Lenovo ThinkPad X220 internal speakers (FRU 04W1412).jpg
results.desc: This image displays the original internal stereo speaker kit (FRU 04W1412, P/N 23.40861.001) for Lenovo ThinkPad X220 series laptops. Both left and right channel speakers are combined in a single plastic frame with a standard JST-style signal connector. These speakers are used in ThinkPad X220, X220i, and X230 models, providing system notification, media, and general audio output. Length of the assembly and connector pinout fit the original design specification for X220/X230. A small square magnet is visible on the speaker assembly. This magnet is used in conjunction with a Hall effect sensor located on the ThinkPad X220 display assembly. When the lid is closed, the magnet triggers the sensor, enabling automatic sleep or suspend mode and ensuring the laptop wakes or sleeps appropriately when opened or closed.
